Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; nothing else altered, no OCR error corrected, nothing retyped. University of California Libraries scan; clean OCR. Pinkerton reprints the English versions from Churchill's Collection (1704) for the Capuchin voyages and gives Proyart's History of Loango in English.
Content note: The African volume of Pinkerton's collection. The Kongo matter is the 'Voyage to Congo by Angelo and Carli', 'Merolla's Voyage to Congo', Battell's 'Strange Adventures' in Angola, and Proyart's History of Loango, Kakongo and other kingdoms (1776); the rest of the volume (the Cape, Guinea, Senegal, Ethiopia, Madagascar, the Canaries, Park) is not this world's.
